description: Finds Platinumride private transfer routes between Gulf cities. Accepts city names, IATA airport codes, Arabic names, common typos and free-text origin/destination queries. Returns indicative per-vehicle 'from' prices in local currency and approximate AED, travel time, distance, border crossings and booking links. Unmatched queries return an empty route list with suggestions.

from.description: Origin city, airport code or Arabic name, e.g. 'Dubai', 'DXB', 'دبي'.

internationalOnly.description: Whether results are limited to routes with a border crossing.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

q.description: Free-text origin and destination query, e.g. 'DXB to Riyadh' or 'دبي إلى الرياض'.

to.description: Destination city, airport code or Arabic name, e.g. 'Muscat', 'MCT'.

name: search_routes
title: Search transfer routes
